1.text: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

2.text: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

3.text: [And] who created seven heavens in layers.<sup foot_note="228047">1</sup> You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

footnotes.228047: - i.e., one covering or fitting over the other.

4.text: Then return [your] vision twice again.<sup foot_note="228048">1</sup> [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

5.text: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils<sup foot_note="228049">1</sup> and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

footnotes.228049: - Thereby driving them from the heavens and preventing them from eavesdropping.  See 72:8-9.

6.text: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

7.text: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

8.text: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

9.text: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

10.text: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

11.text: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation<sup foot_note="228050">1</sup> for the companions of the Blaze.

footnotes.228050: - From all good and from Allāh's mercy.

12.text: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

13.text: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

14.text: Does He who created not know,<sup foot_note="228051">1</sup> while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

footnotes.228051: - Another accepted meaning is "Does He not know those whom He created...?"

15.text: It is He who made the earth tame<sup foot_note="228052">1</sup> for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

16.text: Do you feel secure that He who is above<sup foot_note="228053">1</sup> would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?<sup foot_note="228054">2</sup>

footnotes.228054: In a circular motion, as in an earthquake.

17.text: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

18.text: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

19.text: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

20.text: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

21.text: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

22.text: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

23.text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

24.text: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

25.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

26.text: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

27.text: But when they see it<sup foot_note="228055">1</sup> approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."<sup foot_note="228056">2</sup>

footnotes.228055: The punishment of which they were warned.
footnotes.228056: When they challenged their prophets, saying, "Bring on the punishment, if you are truthful."

28.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:<sup foot_note="228057">1</sup> whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

29.text: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

30.text: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
